decisions.reason: The collection-method change does not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, pool funding, or 100-sale draw condition.
Manual prize collection does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, expiration, or post-draw reset behavior.
The current About-page copy already describes prizes as announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click, so it remains consistent with the confirmed manual-claim flow.
Prize-winner email notification remains valid regardless of whether the notified winner must use a conditional claim button.
The hero's prize promotion, wording, and layout do not specify or depend on the prize collection method.
Prize collection behavior does not change royalty enforcement, marketplace controls, royalty amount, or secondary-sale allocation.
The embedded wallet and dashboard can still provide prize access and receive a claimed prize; the existing state does not require automatic prize transfer.
The prize collection method has no effect on the landing-page book cover's location, size, visibility, or overlap constraints.
Changing how winners collect prizes does not alter transfer of the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired prize tickets upon NFT resale.
The source decision concerns collection of winning prizes, not the separate automatic $5 referral commission payout.
